body.p: (Phases 2 to 4 planning; PLAN.md leaves the targets to the end of Phase 1). Measured by sxml-qt4 run (release, one process per test set) and, for XSLT, the driver of packet ; "wrong error" counts as passed (), as the QT4 guide allows.

item.p: Denominators: the cases whose spec applies (XP40, XQ40, XSLT40; a case spec replaces the set's), minus those that need a non-goal: features schemaImport, schemaValidation, typedData, staticTyping, XQUpdate, fullText, xpath-1.0-compatibility, fn-transform-XSLT, fn-invisible-xml, remote_http, expath-file, binary, advanced-uca-fallback, schema-location-hint; sets upd-, ft-, bin-, expath-, misc-HtmlTestSuite, fn-parse-html, fn-html-doc, fn-invisible-xml, fn-transform (). About 31,500 XP40 and 41,200 XQ40 cases (9,700 of them XQ-only). XSLT: spec XSLT40 outside the strm and sandp groups and without the features schema_aware, streaming, dtd, XML_1.1, XSD_1.1, backwards_compatibility, HTML4, ICU_spellout: about 8,700 of 12,627. Cases with serialization assertions count (they fail until 3.3).

Targets: Phase 2, XP40 ≥ 90%, each area fn, op, prod, map, array, math, xs ≥ 80%. Phase 3, XQ40 ≥ 85%, XQ-only ≥ 75%, method-* ≥ 80%, XP40 kept. Phase 4, XSLT in scope ≥ 70%, twelve core sets ≥ 80% (listed in docs/tasks/phase-4.md). Every gate also needs zero crashes, leaks and "error" outcomes.

Why these: Phase 1 ended at 21,443 of about 31,500 XP40 cases (68%). The known causes are missing work, not design faults: unknown functions 5,596 cases, regex 480, unlowered constructs 395, math 181, collations 100; together about 21% of the denominator, so 90% asks for that plus a third of the remaining failures. XQuery adds 9,700 XQ-only cases that share the XPath core; 75% of those with 90% of the rest gives 86%. The XSLT suite is younger, its cases compare whole outputs and many test packages and error codes, so 70% is the first honest bar; regex-syntax (987) and error (500) alone are 17% of it.
A target is changed only by a new record, before its gate review.
